svg.title: Same star field, same 14 mm frame at the celestial equator, same 60 s exposure; only the sensor motion differs. Panel 1: no rotation, translation follows the equator point. Panel 2: rotation and translation fitted to the top third of the frame, applied to the whole frame. Panel 3: one rigid motion fitted by least squares to the whole frame (model). Grey lines: untracked sky motion; orange: residual after tracking; both magnified 20 times. Idealised model, not PENTAX's control.

g.font-family: system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue','Hiragino Sans','Noto Sans JP',Arial,sans-serif
g.text: (3) is a MODEL: one sensor, least-squares over the whole frame
14 mm · full frame · 60 s · equator at frame centre · idealised model
